description: Defines the ChunkHeader struct used for representing PNG chunk headers within the PDFsharp library, including properties for position, size, and chunk characteristics.

classes.name: ChunkHeader
classes.description: A readonly struct representing the header of a data chunk in a PNG file, including position, length, name, and properties to determine chunk attributes.

methods.name: ChunkHeader
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a ChunkHeader instance with position, length, and name, with validation for length.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides the default method to provide a string representation of the chunk header.
